text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the race where the best of the seniors gather—the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio, brimming with motivation, is ready to show off her skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Driven by those feelings, she heads out to face an incredibly difficult match.
